description: Implementation of the QuicSessionKey class, including constructors, comparison operators, and aliasing check, used for managing QUIC session keys in the Chromium project.

classes.name: QuicSessionKey
classes.description: Represents a unique key for a QUIC session, encapsulating server ID, socket tag, network anonymization, DNS policy, and ALPN requirement.

methods.name: QuicSessionKey(const HostPortPair&, PrivacyMode, const SocketTag&, const NetworkAnonymizationKey&, SecureDnsPolicy, bool)
methods.description: Constructs a QuicSessionKey from host/port, privacy mode, socket tag, network anonymization key, DNS policy, and ALPN requirement.

methods.name: QuicSessionKey(const std::string&, uint16_t, PrivacyMode, const SocketTag&, const NetworkAnonymizationKey&, SecureDnsPolicy, bool)
methods.description: Constructs a QuicSessionKey from host string, port, privacy mode, socket tag, network anonymization key, DNS policy, and ALPN requirement.

methods.name: QuicSessionKey(const quic::QuicServerId&, const SocketTag&, const NetworkAnonymizationKey&, SecureDnsPolicy, bool)
methods.description: Constructs a QuicSessionKey from a server ID, socket tag, network anonymization key, DNS policy, and ALPN requirement.

methods.name: operator<(const QuicSessionKey&) const
methods.description: Less-than comparison operator for ordering QuicSessionKey objects.

methods.name: operator==(const QuicSessionKey&) const
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for QuicSessionKey objects.

methods.name: CanUseForAliasing(const QuicSessionKey&) const
methods.description: Checks if this key can be used for aliasing with another key based on privacy mode, socket tag, network key, DNS policy, and ALPN requirement.
